subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
6.
Which of the following best represents the three party relationship in this
assurance engagement?
(A)  Ravi & Mehta, internal audit staff and the CSR department.
(B)  Ravi & Mehta, management of Fresh Farm Foods Ltd., and the intended
users of the report.

AUDITING AND ETHICS

5
(C)  Ravi & Mehta, the company's board of directors and its external auditors
(D)  Ravi & Mehta, employees interviewed during site visits and the intended
users of the report.
(2 Marks)
